name: smwsprites-crystal-core-v1
title: Crystal Core v1.5
description:
This is a simple "boss" that shoots projectiles at Mario and takes a customizable amount of hits. It's only damaged by collission with Marine Pop's projectile, so make sure you have a Marine Pop in your level.

You might want to use No More Sprite Tile Limits.
Requested by Daizo Dee Von.

v1.5: Now can teleport around and lock the screen, as well as allow it to scroll again after being defeated.

Now SA-1 hybrid.
